lines.vi: Chào cháu. Cháu bị làm sao?

lines.en: I've got a cold. I have a runny nose and a cough.
lines.vi: Cháu bị cảm ạ. Cháu sổ mũi và ho.
Cháu có thấy chóng mặt không?

lines.en: No, but I feel very tired.
lines.vi: Không ạ, nhưng cháu rất mệt.

lines.en: You should stay in bed and drink lots of water.

Cháu có phải tiêm không ạ?

lines.en: No. Just rest. You'll get better soon.
lines.vi: Không. Chỉ cần nghỉ ngơi. Cháu sẽ sớm khỏi thôi.

lines.en: What do you do to stay healthy?

lines.en: I eat a balanced diet and play outdoors.
lines.vi: Tớ ăn uống cân bằng và chơi ngoài trời.

lines.en: Me too. I also do yoga with my mum.
lines.vi: Tớ cũng vậy. Tớ còn tập yoga với mẹ nữa.

lines.en: Cool! And I always go to bed at bedtime!
lines.vi: Hay đấy! Và tớ luôn đi ngủ đúng giờ!

writing.target: Wash your hands to stop germs.
Oranges have a lot of vitamins.
To stay healthy, I|You should|You shouldn't

text_en: Doctors say that healthy habits are very important for children.
First, eat a balanced diet with lots of fruit and vegetables.
Don't eat too much junk food or too many sweets.
Second, drink water instead of fizzy drinks.
Third, play outdoors and exercise every day.
Running, swimming and cycling all make your heart strong.
Next, wash your hands often to stop germs.
Finally, sleep for about ten hours every night.
If you follow these habits, you will feel happy and full of energy!

questions.q: What should you drink instead of fizzy drinks?
Why should you wash your hands often?
How long should children sleep every night?
